subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: After shared reply-session conflict self-healing, should Discord retain an additional channel-level retry for the identical error?
rationale: The repository favors one canonical runtime path and requires explicit intent for fallback stacks; both approaches are plausible, but only maintainers can choose layered resilience versus lifecycle-only recovery.

options.title: Shared recovery only
options.body: Land the lifecycle-owned repair and close or narrow this PR unless a distinct Discord-only race is demonstrated.

options.title: Layered Discord fallback
options.body: Retain this channel retry only after abort cancellation and live proof that it remains necessary and exact-once beside shared recovery.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery only
recommendation.body: Land the lifecycle-owned repair and close or narrow this PR unless a distinct Discord-only race is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across both the Discord processor and shared session lifecycle where the boundary choice must be made.
